page.overview:
Who is Hell Devil?

The の|Jigoku no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of Hell, and serves as a supporting antagonist in the International Assassins arc and a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc, where it faces the Chainsaw Devil.

The Hell Devil takes the form of a centaur with a featureless head except for its giant mouth which is open in a grimace. It is covered with taut flesh which is constantly burning.

The Hell Devil's personality is currently unknown.

After managing to incapacitate Denji inside a mall with the Curse Devil while transforming Tolka into a doll, Santa Claus uses her contract with the Hell Devil to send everyone inside the mall to the depths of Hell. By doing so, one of her perfect dolls and three children are sacrificed in the process. A single finger also appears to claim the three children, though it is not shown what exactly happens to them. Once that is dealt with, a giant hand with six fingers descends from the sky to warp the Devil Hunters inside the building to Hell in an instant.
